app.subtitle: Find and submit to hackathons
app.description: From Devpost, the leading hackathon platform. Find hackathons, register, build, and submit, all without leaving ChatGPT or Codex. An optional build assistant walks you through ideation, scoping, and planning to help you ship a strong project.

mcp.auth: OAuth (PKCE) via https://auth-devpost.com; scopes mcp:tools, mcp:read, mcp:write

notes.source_of_truth: This file mirrors the app's OpenAI App Store submission (devpost-hackathons v1.0.0). app.version tracks the SUBMISSION version, not .codex-plugin/plugin.json (the dev-install manifest, bumped per local change). When the submission changes, update this file to match. Live hackathon data always comes from the devpost MCP server, never from here.
